object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. The column, merge and alignment results are read from the editor, not from the saved object; the menu entries for Add column and Column alignment aren't checked.
object.description: In the table editor on a two-column table with a header row: select a body cell and add a row below and a column to the right; select the two header cells and merge them; select a cell in the first column and set its alignment to center. Merge the two header cells of a fresh table too. Expected: three rows, then three columns; the first header cell spans two columns and each position is covered exactly once; the first column is centred. The Table menu offers Merge cells.
